Population increased in Basingstoke and Deane

The estimated population of Basingstoke and Deane in 2024 was 193,110 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

This meant that Basingstoke and Deane's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Basingstoke and Deane increased by 4%.

Over this slightly longer period, Basingstoke and Deane was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Basingstoke and Deane

The average (median) age rose to 40.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Basingstoke and Deane has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Basingstoke and Deane is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Basingstoke and Deane's population of 193,110 usual residents was made up of:

  • 36,576 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.9%)
  • 121,904 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63.1%)
  • 34,630 people aged 65 years and over, (17.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Basingstoke and Deane has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (17.9% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Basingstoke and Deane, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Basingstoke and Deane
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Basingstoke and Deane, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 502 people (0.3%). In total, there were 1,972 births and 1,470 deaths in Basingstoke and Deane.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 43 (0%). There were 9,168 people entering the area and 9,211 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Basingstoke and Deane's population of 1,553 (0.8%) as a result of 2,291 people entering the area and 738 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Basingstoke and Deane was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Basingstoke and Deane in mid-2023 is 191,048.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 397 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 453 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 850 people.
